name: conv8
note: Gesprächsprobe aus den Runden 111–124 (verbraucht: nach dem ersten Lauf angepasst)

en: i locked myself out of my apartment
ok, my neighbour has a spare key actually

the deadline is in six weeks

i don't want to start a fight
how do i bring it up?
